def _apply_mask(scores: Tensor, mask: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    """Apply causal mask by setting masked positions to -infinity.
    """
    adder = (Tensor(np.ones_like(mask.data)) - mask) * MASK_VALUE
    return scores + adder
